/.title: SwordWeave · Free Modular Tabletop RPG
/.description: Free modular tabletop RPG in v0.1 alpha. Build characters and abilities from reusable rules, read the books, and use browser tools for your table.

/start.title: How to play · SwordWeave
/start.description: Follow Bartholomew from character concept through starting access, sheet composition, and a turn at the table.

/character.title: Character creation & builder guide · SwordWeave
/character.description: Create a SwordWeave character with Quickbuild or the Complete character flow. Learn attributes, Build Units and reusable rules before opening the builder.

/creating.title: Create abilities, effects & rules · SwordWeave
/creating.description: Compose SwordWeave abilities and effects from reusable primitives. Use the same owned rules in new actions, create in the Atelier, and adapt Library ideas.

/rules.title: Rules & play guide · SwordWeave
/rules.description: Learn SwordWeave: primitives, capabilities, effects, heritages, rolls, combat rhythm, upkeep, damage, and your character sheet.

/combat.title: Combat rhythm · SwordWeave
/combat.description: A shared round of intent, timing, and consequence. Learn the Council Phase, Fast / Measured / Heavy tracks, and reactions in SwordWeave.

/books.title: Free rulebooks · SwordWeave v0.1 alpha
/books.description: Read or download the free SwordWeave Player's Handbook, Game Master's Guide and SRD in light or dark editions.

/about.title: Creator & open licenses · SwordWeave
/about.description: Meet Marius Ion, the creator of SwordWeave. Learn why the game is open, how its MIT and CC BY 4.0 licenses apply, and where to find credits.

/contact.title: Contact · SwordWeave
/contact.description: Questions, table feedback or creator collaborations: send Mashu a message at contact@swordweave.quest.

/attributions.title: Credits & attributions · SwordWeave
/attributions.description: The artists, icons, and open licenses behind SwordWeave. Full game-icons.net contributor credits.

/privacy.title: Privacy & cookies · SwordWeave
/privacy.description: How SwordWeave uses essential storage, optional analytics, and contact messages.
